fields.label: Brand Name
fields.description: Shown in the navbar and browser title. Leave empty to use the Company name.

fields.label: Brand Logo
fields.description: Use a square mark (e.g. 256x256 PNG/SVG): it is shown as the app icon on the apps screen and in the desk.

fields.label: Apply Brand Colours to Desk
fields.description: Maps the brand colour onto Desk's primary colour. Turn this off if a Desk theme app is installed and should own the colours.

fields.label: Core (always on)
fields.description: Stock, Selling, Accounts and POS are always enabled. Customers can be created straight from POS without the CRM module.

fields.label: Loyalty Program
fields.description: Creates (or re-enables) a default points program and enrols new customers automatically.

fields.label: Group Variants in POS
fields.description: POS shows one card per product (e.g. one per shoe model) and asks for Size/Colour when it is tapped. Scanning a barcode still adds the exact variant. Turn off to get ERPNext's standard one-card-per-variant list.

fields.label: Optional Modules
fields.description: Off by default. Ticking one un-hides its sidebar icon and grants it to Store Owner. Saving re-applies the navigation.

fields.label: Online Store / E-Commerce (needs the webshop app)
Messaging (planned)
fields.description: WhatsApp/SMS is not built yet. See the app README, section 'Messaging extension point'.

fields.label: Main / Central Warehouse
fields.description: Default source for store replenishment requests.

fields.label: In-Transit Warehouse
fields.description: Goods sit here between 'dispatched' and 'received at destination'.

fields.label: Material Requests Need Approval
fields.description: Staff submit requests for approval; a Store/Warehouse Manager or Store Owner approves.

fields.label: Doctypes Restricted by Location
fields.default:
Sales Invoice
POS Invoice
POS Profile
Sales Order
Delivery Note
Stock Reconciliation
fields.description: One per line. A staff member's warehouses are applied to these doctypes as native User Permissions ('Applicable For'). Stock Entry and Material Request are always scoped by this app, and reports like Stock Balance are never blocked.

fields.label: Doctypes Restricted by POS Profile
fields.default:
POS Opening Entry
POS Closing Entry
fields.description: One per line. Restricted to the POS Profiles of the staff member's warehouses.
